=== spacing around operators and after commas
tariff "t"
let a=1+2*3
let b = f( 1 ,2 )
let c = [ 1,2 ]
---
tariff "t"
let a = 1 + 2 * 3
let b = f(1, 2)
let c = [1, 2]

=== record braces get spaces
tariff "t"
let a = {code:"FSC",amount:$10}
---
tariff "t"
let a = { code: "FSC", amount: $10 }

=== indentation is two spaces
tariff "t"
if a {
        note "x"
    if b {
note "y"
    }
}
---
tariff "t"
if a {
  note "x"
  if b {
    note "y"
  }
}

=== at most one blank line
tariff "t"
let a = 1



let b = 2
---
tariff "t"
let a = 1

let b = 2

=== no blank lines at block starts and ends
tariff "t"
if a {

  note "x"

}
---
tariff "t"
if a {
  note "x"
}

=== blank line after the header is kept
tariff "t"
let a = 1
---
tariff "t"
let a = 1

=== numbers, units and text as written
tariff "t"
let a = 1_200+2.50
let b = 500lb
let c = "a\tb \u{1F600} {{x}}"
let d = $1_000.00/mi
---
tariff "t"
let a = 1_200 + 2.50
let b = 500 lb
let c = "a\tb \u{1F600} {{x}}"
let d = $1_000.00/mi

=== unit after a number gets one space
tariff "t"
let a = 30   lb/ft3
---
tariff "t"
let a = 30 lb/ft3

=== comments stay in place
tariff "t"
// before
let a = 1 // trailing
// between

// after a blank
let b = 2
// at the end
---
tariff "t"
// before
let a = 1 // trailing
// between

// after a blank
let b = 2
// at the end

=== comments inside blocks
tariff "t"
if a {
  // first
  note "x" // trailing
  // last
}
---
tariff "t"
if a {
  // first
  note "x" // trailing
  // last
}

=== comment in an empty block
tariff "t"
if a {
  // nothing yet
}
---
tariff "t"
if a {
  // nothing yet
}

=== comments inside a broken list
tariff "t"
let a = [
  1, // one
  // two comes next
  2,
]
---
tariff "t"
let a = [
  1, // one
  // two comes next
  2,
]

=== comment between operands of a chain
tariff "t"
let a = linehaul // freight
  + fuel
---
tariff "t"
let a = linehaul
  // freight
  + fuel

=== comment inside an expression moves after the statement
tariff "t"
let a = x * // why
  y
let b = 2
---
tariff "t"
let a = x * y
// why
let b = 2

=== doc comments stay attached
tariff "t"

/// The file.

/// Paid per mile.
input rate: Money/mi = $2.35/mi

/// A zone.
enum Zone {
  /// The first.
  A,
  B,
}
---
tariff "t"

/// The file.

/// Paid per mile.
input rate: Money/mi = $2.35/mi

/// A zone.
enum Zone {
  /// The first.
  A,
  B,
}

=== long arguments break one per line
tariff "t"
let surcharge = stepPercent(fuel.price ?? fail "No fuel price", peg: fuelPeg, step: $0.05/gal, perStep: 0.5%)
---
tariff "t"
let surcharge = stepPercent(
  fuel.price ?? fail "No fuel price",
  peg: fuelPeg,
  step: $0.05/gal,
  perStep: 0.5%,
)

=== long lists break with a trailing comma
tariff "t"
let zips = ["606", "607", "608", "609", "610", "611", "612", "613", "614", "615", "616", "617", "618"]
---
tariff "t"
let zips = [
  "606",
  "607",
  "608",
  "609",
  "610",
  "611",
  "612",
  "613",
  "614",
  "615",
  "616",
  "617",
  "618",
]

=== long records break
tariff "t"
let a = { code: "FSC", description: "Fuel surcharge for this lane", amount: $10.00, minimum: $25.00 }
---
tariff "t"
let a = {
  code: "FSC",
  description: "Fuel surcharge for this lane",
  amount: $10.00,
  minimum: $25.00,
}

=== long chains break before the operator
tariff "t"
let total = linehaul + fuelSurcharge + extraDrops + hazmatCharge + detentionCharges + residentialFee + liftgate
let ok = shipment.hazmat and shipment.reefer and lane.interstate and lane.crossBorder and customer.code == "X"
let w = shipment.weight ?? shipment.commodities.sum(c => c.weight) ?? fallbackWeightForThisLane ?? 0 lb
---
tariff "t"
let total = linehaul
  + fuelSurcharge
  + extraDrops
  + hazmatCharge
  + detentionCharges
  + residentialFee
  + liftgate
let ok = shipment.hazmat
  and shipment.reefer
  and lane.interstate
  and lane.crossBorder
  and customer.code == "X"
let w = shipment.weight
  ?? shipment.commodities.sum(c => c.weight)
  ?? fallbackWeightForThisLane
  ?? 0 lb

=== nested breaks keep inner groups flat
tariff "t"
let a = f(alpha, beta, gamma(1, 2), deltaDeltaDelta, epsilonEpsilonEpsilon, zetaZetaZetaZeta, etaEtaEta)
---
tariff "t"
let a = f(
  alpha,
  beta,
  gamma(1, 2),
  deltaDeltaDelta,
  epsilonEpsilonEpsilon,
  zetaZetaZetaZeta,
  etaEtaEta,
)

=== short lines stay flat
tariff "t"
let a = f(
  1,
  2,
)
let b = [
  1,
]
---
tariff "t"
let a = f(1, 2)
let b = [1]

=== match arms are not aligned
tariff "t"
let perCwt = match shipment.weight {
  ..500 lb          => $42.00/cwt
  500 lb..2_000 lb  => $35.50/cwt
  _                 => $22.75/cwt
}
---
tariff "t"
let perCwt = match shipment.weight {
  ..500 lb => $42.00/cwt
  500 lb..2_000 lb => $35.50/cwt
  _ => $22.75/cwt
}

=== match statement
tariff "t"
match x {
  A => {
    note "a"
  }
  B=>note "b"

  _ => {}
}
---
tariff "t"
match x {
  A => {
    note "a"
  }
  B => {
    note "b"
  }

  _ => {}
}

=== if expression stays on one line
tariff "t"
let a = if x>1 {$10} else {$20}
---
tariff "t"
let a = if x > 1 { $10 } else { $20 }

=== long if expression breaks
tariff "t"
let a = if shipment.weight ?? 0 lb > 10_000 lb { heavyRateForTheLane * miles } else { lightRateForTheLane * miles }
---
tariff "t"
let a = if shipment.weight ?? 0 lb > 10_000 lb {
  heavyRateForTheLane * miles
} else {
  lightRateForTheLane * miles
}

=== functions and params
library "l"
fn deadhead(empty:Distance,rate:Money/mi)->Money{
let paid=(empty-50 mi).max(0 mi)
return rate*paid
}
fn residential(fee:Money=$95)=fee
---
library "l"
fn deadhead(empty: Distance, rate: Money/mi) -> Money {
  let paid = (empty - 50 mi).max(0 mi)
  return rate * paid
}
fn residential(fee: Money = $95) = fee

=== long parameter lists break
library "l"
fn businessDuration(start: DateTime, end: DateTime, open: Int = 8, close: Int = 17, zone: Text = "UTC") -> Duration = end - start
---
library "l"
fn businessDuration(
  start: DateTime,
  end: DateTime,
  open: Int = 8,
  close: Int = 17,
  zone: Text = "UTC",
) -> Duration = end - start

=== use, enum and type layouts
library "l"
use std.ltl.{deficit,Break} as ltl
enum Zone{A,B,C}
type Break={from:Weight,rate:Money/cwt,minimum:Money?}
private const LIMIT:Int=3
---
library "l"
use std.ltl.{ deficit, Break } as ltl
enum Zone { A, B, C }
type Break = { from: Weight, rate: Money/cwt, minimum: Money? }
private const LIMIT: Int = 3

=== charges
tariff "t"
charge "Linehaul"(quantity:miles,rate:rate)
charge "Fuel" as FSC=linehaul*pct
---
tariff "t"
charge "Linehaul" (quantity: miles, rate: rate)
charge "Fuel" as FSC = linehaul * pct

=== total clauses
tariff "t"
minimum   $450
round  half   even to cents
round up to $5
---
tariff "t"
minimum $450
round half even to cents
round up to $5

=== tests
tariff "t"
test "x"{
given shipment.weight=1 lb
expect fails "no"
expect total==$1
}
---
tariff "t"
test "x" {
  given shipment.weight = 1 lb
  expect fails "no"
  expect total == $1
}

=== lambdas with one and two parameters
tariff "t"
let a = xs.map((x) => x)
let b = xs.sortBy( (a,b) => a )
---
tariff "t"
let a = xs.map(x => x)
let b = xs.sortBy((a, b) => a)

=== parentheses are kept
tariff "t"
let a = ((1 + 2)) * 3
---
tariff "t"
let a = ((1 + 2)) * 3

=== optional chaining and ranges
tariff "t"
let a = x?.y ?? 0
let b = 1 ..= 3
let c = .. 5
---
tariff "t"
let a = x?.y ?? 0
let b = 1..=3
let c = ..5

=== a file with errors is not formatted
tariff "t"
let a = 1 +
---
! refused: syntax Expected a value after `+`

=== a file with a stray doc is formatted
tariff "t"
let a = 1
/// stray

let b = 2
---
tariff "t"
let a = 1
/// stray

let b = 2

=== condition file
condition "c"
input zips:List<Text>=[]
lane.destination.zip3 in zips and (shipment.weight??0 lb)<10_000 lb
---
condition "c"
input zips: List<Text> = []
lane.destination.zip3 in zips and (shipment.weight ?? 0 lb) < 10_000 lb

=== trailing comment after the header
tariff "t" // the name
let a = 1
---
tariff "t" // the name
let a = 1

=== comment before the header
// leading
tariff "t"
---
// leading
tariff "t"

=== require and for
tariff "t"
require let w=shipment.weight else "needs weight"
for s in shipment.stops where s.dwell!=none{
continue
}
---
tariff "t"
require let w = shipment.weight else "needs weight"
for s in shipment.stops where s.dwell != none {
  continue
}

=== deep text interpolation stays as written
tariff "t"
note "{ a + b } and { f( 1 ) }"
---
tariff "t"
note "{ a + b } and { f( 1 ) }"
